title: Intune App Deployment Troubleshooting & Failure Remediation (Win32/LOB/Store)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (cross-domain endpoint troubleshooting/operations; diagnostic method + scripts, live-environment care).
Vendor/product-specific console internals are deferred to the vendor's official documentation; the Intune/Entra/Windows side is authored at exact click-by-click detail.
hook: Turn an Intune app-install failure into a known error code and fix
problem: A Win32 app sits at “waiting for install status” or fails with a raw error code, and nobody knows if it's detection, requirements, a dependency, or the ESP. This toolkit gives you a root-cause method and scripts for Intune app deployment failures — Win32, LOB, and Store apps — decoding install/detection/requirement/dependency errors and reading the IntuneManagementExtension logs, so you fix the real cause fast.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the app-delivery pipeline (assign → requirement → download → install → detection → report), the ESP's role, and the model behind the diagnostic tree.
Requirements Guide — what you need (Intune roles, Graph read access, device log access) with how to verify each.
Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom tree (requirement not met, detection wrong, dependency/supersedence, download failure, exit-code decode, ESP block) with the exact checks per branch.

5 PowerShell scripts — app-assignment/readiness discovery, per-device install + detection validation, an app deployment coverage/failure report, safe re-attempt/cleanup remediation, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (requirement met, installed, detected), plus Best Practices for detection rules and phased app rollout.
short: A root-cause method and scripts for Intune app-deployment failures (Win32/LOB/Store) — requirement, detection, dependency, download, exit-code, and ESP issues, with log triage. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
